[SQP-2] expected: Local file creation and edits are expected for installing and configuring this tool; SKILL.md names PROJECT_DIR, config files, .env, and data/papers.sqlite3, though a clearer upfront warning would improve user expectations.
[SQP-2] expected: Outbound calls to paper sources and configured LLM providers are expected for paper fetching and summarization; the documentation mentions network access, arXiv/Hugging Face, and LLM keys, but privacy wording could be clearer.
[SQP-2] expected: The bootstrap script creates or updates the project directory, virtualenv, dependencies, and .env template only when the user runs it; this is installer behavior, not hidden execution.
[E1] expected: The flagged curl/wget path downloads a ZIP of the linked GitHub repository when git is unavailable; the artifact does not show secrets or user data being uploaded.
[PE3] expected: The .env references are for creating and loading the user’s configured LLM credentials. This is expected, but users should not point ENV_FILE at untrusted files because shell sourcing can execute file contents.
[VirusTotal] expected: VirusTotal telemetry was clean and aligns with the artifact review, but it was treated only as supporting signal.
[staticScan] expected: The supplied static scan reported no findings, consistent with the absence of artifact-backed exfiltration, destructive behavior, or deception.
llm.guidance: Install only if you trust the linked GitHub project and are comfortable with it downloading code, installing Python dependencies, and using an external LLM provider.
